title: Chapter 386: Promise
content:
Chapter 386: Promise

Seeing Lu Daosheng's method of understanding the heavens, the creatures in the Chaos Realm were extremely shocked.

In their eyes, the three gods who were arrogant, this lord of the deserted city could easily be destroyed by just turning his hands.

Is this Lu Daosheng’s true strength?

Suddenly, they thought of what Lu Daosheng said that day.

"Listen, any tribe that attacks our human race this time will come to my ancestral land to kowtow and admit their mistakes within one day, otherwise,

"Extermination of the clan."

At the beginning, although everyone thought that Lu Daosheng was powerful, it was still difficult to convince people to destroy the gods.

After all, the Three Gods have stood tall in the Chaos Realm for countless years, and their background is even more unfathomable.

If it was so easy to be exterminated, it would not have been possible to develop to this level today.

But now, the facts are in front of them.

The three great gods that were once high and above have fallen now, and there are no living creatures in the entire tribe.

More importantly, the three gods did not even leave a single cent, as if they had never existed.

Lu Daosheng, erased the three gods!

At the same time, a distant place.

In a magnificent world.

The six giant pillars of the sky are particularly conspicuous, and they exude dazzling light and shine on the entire world.

It also seems to be the pillar of the world, separating the heaven and earth.

And below the pillar were countless creatures. They looked pious and kept worshiping the giant pillar, murmured: "Bless all the gods, I wish to give everything to God."

If you look closely, you will find that these creatures have no eyes and their movements are stiff.

No one knows what these creatures have experienced.

At this moment, one of the six giant pillars suddenly trembled, and then the light coming from the giant pillar gradually dimmed.

"You're injured."

A shocking voice came from another giant pillar.

The somewhat dim giant pillar was silent for a moment, his voice was low, "I saw that ant."

"That ant!"

Another voice came.

It seems very angry.

"He's coming."

"Haha, it's just another worshiper."

"I hope so."

As the sound ended, the land of the gods fell into silence again, leaving only the creatures under the giant pillars and the sunless worship.

.........

Chaos Realm, in the Desolate City.

Lu Daosheng sat on the throne in the main hall of the City Lord's Mansion and glanced at the people below.

This time, the people are particularly aligned.

I haven't felt this way for a long time.

Lu Daosheng sighed in his heart, then his eyes changed and his voice slightly sank.

"You are now in a completely insufficient position for your current situation."

Hearing this, everyone below couldn't help but feel excited.

Is the city lord going to give them a small meal again?

Some people were happy, and Ao Qing was even more excited and her tail was rising into the sky.

He cheered in his heart, "It must be the master. If the master has been in the deserted city, they will not watch the little master be bullied."

Next, Lu Daosheng continued, "So I plan to let you improve your strength first."

While talking, Lu Daosheng couldn't help but sigh slightly.

"Everyone of you here can be said to be a monster in a world. As long as you are given time, you will definitely become top-level strong people."

"But unfortunately, this is a wasteland city, and your cultivation speed is still not fast enough."

The promotion speed of Huangcheng is really too fast. Even if the people in Huangcheng are talented, they are still difficult to keep up.

Just like now, I suddenly jumped from the original world to the current Chaos Realm. Even a demon like Yan Lingyun could not react for a while.

Everyone was silent for a moment when they listened to Lu Daosheng's words.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng coughed lightly and then said, "Next, I will arrange you, and leave the rest to you. This time, you have to rely on yourself to practice."

As he said that, without waiting for everyone to react, Lu Daosheng spread his palms and appeared in his palms.

The next moment, a suction force that could not resist pulled everyone in, and in an instant, the hall suddenly became quiet.

Yan Lingyun and Lu Xue stood there, slightly stunned.

Below, only Ao Qing was alone. He looked around, looking at him at a loss.

"Master, what about me?"

Why is he the only one left?

Ah, I understand. It must be the master who planned to bring him with him, so that he would definitely practice faster.

Woo woo woo woo woo, the master is so nice to me.

Thinking of this, Ao Qing's eyes were filled with tears, and he almost rushed towards Lu Daosheng's thigh.

"Ao Qing."

"Master, I'm here!"

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, "Are you, let's go to the demon clan that day first? There is a chance for you there."

"When you come back, I'll arrange for you to go somewhere else."

After saying this, Lu Daosheng stood up and left.

Ao Qing stood there, silent for a long time.

Yan Lingyun smiled and shook her head, then said to Lu Xue beside her, "Xiaoxue, mom, go back first."

Then Yan Lingyun left the hall.

Lu Xue blinked and looked at Ao Qing.

Under Lu Daosheng's power, she quickly woke up.

At the same time, she also knew that she was contaminated by something dirty, and she felt a little guilty when she thought of this.

I actually wanted to do that kind of thing.

Fortunately, bad things didn't happen.

On the contrary, my father changed his past and stayed with him.

This is also a good thing.

"Xiaoqing, I'll send you to the Heavenly Demon Clan."

Lu Xue smiled.

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing reluctantly showed a smile, "thank you, little master."

Outside the Chaos Realm.

Lu Daosheng slowly walked out of the Chaos Realm.

Looking at the endless starry sky in front of him, Lu Daosheng sighed.

I have experienced a lot along the way.

What kind of enemy he has never seen?

In the past, he would let his hands solve the problem.

But when facing those who dare to attack their relatives, he will never tolerate them.

"The Land of Gods."

Lu Daosheng narrowed his eyes slightly, and then his palm spread out.

The world in the palm reappears.

"Next, I will arrange for you to go to other worlds. When you get there, you have no support, you can only practice by relying on yourself."

"The world is very big. A world like the Chaos Realm is just a speck of dust in the vast universe."

"I believe that when we meet again, you all have become outstanding strong men."

"I will wait for you in the land of the gods."

After saying that, Lu Daosheng used his right hand to force, and the world in his palm trembled. Then, countless tiny balls of light shot out and flew towards the end of the starry sky.

Look at the world in your palm again.

Lu Daosheng is not only Awei and An Xing on the surface, but also a group of power in secret, which he has never shown before.

Even Awei and others only vaguely guessed it and didn't know the specifics.
